doctors and nurses are fine but the booking system they have at the moment OMG!!!

You input your problem online, which I’m OK with, however it seems that you have little say in the appointment time. When I last used the service I gave a 6 hour window but was assigned an appointment outside this.

The system very much works on the basis that you don’t work, are off sick or are free to walk out of work to attend an appointment, or take a call whenever you like. It makes no consideration to the fact that many working people do not work in the area, and that we can’t just walk out of work. Even taking a call when the practice dictates can be really difficult. We can’t just walk out of meetings or appointments with clients to take calls from a doctor, in some workplaces taking phone calls in work is a disciplinary offence. Their time is precious, I agree, but it’s not fair that we should be prepared to risk our employment in order to attend a medical appointment.

I’m hanging on in there for now as the medical team are fine and I don’t want to make a knee jerk reaction, but If things don’t improve then I’m going to have to find another practice.

4/12/21

EDIT

A couple of years has probably passed since I wrote that review, in utter frustration, having struggled to getting grips with “Ask my GP” and it’s only fair I update it now.

The pandemic has been hard for primary care. GP staff have been given a massive work load and have been hugely under appreciated. Worse even, they’ve had a bad press and accused of laziness because they avoid face to face appointments. Very unfair criticism; telephone appointments are fine.

I’ve had cause to contact to surgery several times since the pandemic began, mainly through “Ask myGP” and can’t fault the service. My requests have been dealt with promptly and appropriately. I’m now quite a fan of “Ask my GP”. It gives the opportunity to accurately explain the problem and photos and other attachments can be included in the request to help with assessment. Thank you all for your hard
